material_definitions: The Li1+xMxHf2-x(PO4)3 systems (M=Cr, Fe, Sc, In, Lu, or Y) were synthesized and sintered above 1293 K to obtain maximum conductivity.
The NASICON-type structure was formed for all samples, sometimes with a small amount of P2/n monoclinic secondary phase.
This specific sample achieved the maximum total conductivity (1.7 x 10^-4 S cm^-1) among the examined Hf systems.
measurements.source_caption: The total conductivity at 298 K for Li1+xMxHf2-x(PO4)3 M=Cr (@);Fe (A);Sc (V);In (ll);Lu (0) orY (e).

material_definitions: The material series is LiHf2(PO4)3 + yLi2O (where y=0.1 in this specific sample).
Li2O acts as a flux to form high density samples and enhances conductivity by reducing grain boundary activation energy.
The sample achieved its maximum conductivity when sintered at 1298 K.
The conductivity enhancement is primarily attributed to the formation of the NASICON-type phase.
measurements.source_caption: Relationship between the total conductivity at 298 K and the sintered temperature for LiHf2(PO4)3+yLi2O system.
